name: @mikode13/github-configuration
description: Shared GitHub organization configuration and reusable workflows for MiKode.

scripts.test: pnpm run test:integration && pnpm run test:fixtures
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit && tsc --noEmit -p tests && pnpm --filter @mikode13/ci-node-fixture run typecheck && pnpm --filter @mikode13/ci-package-fixture run typecheck && node --check eslint.config.js && node --check prettier.config.mjs && node --check docs-toolchain/prettier.config.mjs
scripts.check: pnpm run format:check && pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run ci:contract:check
